text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Cathedral Bluffs Drive, between Sloley Road and Earl Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Cathedral Bluffs Drive.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Cathedral Bluffs Drive, between Sloley Road and Earl Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of six speed humps on Cathedral Bluffs Drive, between Sloley Road and Earl Road. Generally, as shown on Attachments 2 and 3 to the report (December 18, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
